description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p04-sprintf-vecflags.pl.

ROWS BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 2 rows):
  sprintf.t 157  `>%+-v3d< >"\01\02\03"< >+1 .2  .3  <`
  sprintf.t 165  `>%+-v*d< >[3, "\01\02\03"]< >+1 .2  .3  <`

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
    printf("plusv=[%+vd]\n",   "\01\02\03");
    printf("157=[%+-v3d]\n",   "\01\02\03");
  perl: plusv=[+1.2.3]      157=[+1 .2  .3  ]
  PCL : plusv=[+1.+2.+3]    157=[+1 .+2 .+3 ]

CONTROLS THAT AGREE (measured in the same probe): `%v3d`, `%-v3d`, `%v*d`,
`%0*v*d` are byte-identical in perl and PCL.  So the ONLY divergence is the
`+`/space sign flag: perl applies it to the FIRST element only (it is a sign
flag on the whole conversion), PCL passes it down to each element's
per-element format.

Fix area: `sprintf-vector` in `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp` -- strip `+`/space from
the per-element spec and apply it once to the joined result.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md sprintf.t, "reordered
positional+vector" (the note is wrong for these two rows -- there is no
positional specifier in either).

FAMILY: sprintf spec parsing; siblings #1472, #1473.
subject: SILENT WRONG (sprintf): the `+` (and space) flag with `%v` is applied to EVERY vector element instead of once to the whole result -- `sprintf "%+vd", "\01\02\03"` is `+1.2.3` in perl and `+1.+2.+3` in PCL
